SMA.notes: PTFE-filled at the interface. 18 GHz standard, precision/'Super SMA' 26.5-27 GHz. Dielectric OD 0.161-0.165 in (4.09-4.19 mm); pin 0.036-0.037 in.

2.92mm.notes: Air at the interface; mechanically compatible with SMA and 3.5 mm. Support bead (Ultem, Kel-F or PEEK) a few mm behind the reference plane, compensated by an undercut.

Ultem 1000 (PEI).origin: estimate (50 ohm with the outer conductor unchanged)

Kel-F (PCTFE).origin: estimate (50 ohm with the outer conductor unchanged)

PEEK.origin: estimate (50 ohm with the outer conductor unchanged)

2.4mm.notes: Air at the interface; intermates with 1.85 mm. Not compatible with SMA/2.92 mm.

Ultem 1000 (PEI).origin: estimate (50 ohm with the outer conductor unchanged)

Kel-F (PCTFE).origin: estimate (50 ohm with the outer conductor unchanged)

PEEK.origin: estimate (50 ohm with the outer conductor unchanged)

PTFE.note: Hertzon 'Teflon (tm)' has er 2.1 / tand 0.001; solid PTFE in connectors is 2.02-2.08

Ultem 1000 (PEI).note: new material, er 3.15 tand 0.0025 at 1-10 GHz (SABIC data, typical)

Kel-F (PCTFE).note: new material, er 2.3-2.5, tand ~0.005 at GHz (typical)

glass (Corning 7070 type).note: hermetic glass beads, er 4.1 (7070) to 6.7 (Kovar seal glass)

gold-plated BeCu.note: skin depth at 10 GHz 0.79 um; 1.27 um Au is > 1.6 skin depths -> use gold

nickel-plated brass.note: Ni is ferromagnetic; for HF use sigma_eff ~ 2-4e6 S/m (mu_r ~ 1 at >10 GHz but Ni losses are high); 'brass' underestimates the loss

note_2_5mm: There is no standard 2.5 mm coaxial connector. The user's '2.5 mm' is read as 2.4 mm (50 GHz). Nearby sizes: 2.92 mm (40 GHz), 2.4 mm (50 GHz), 1.85 mm (67 GHz, intermates with 2.4 mm).
